evidence.original_label: 在手订单总金额
evidence.excerpt: 截至2026年9月29日，公司在手订单总金额为170.73亿元，与上年同期已自愿性披露的在手订单金额相比，在手订单总金额同比增加88.20%。在手订单含已向客户交付但尚未根据中国会计准则获得客户确认收入的设备订单及将于未来交付的设备订单；以上在手订单数据源自公司内部统计，未经审计

notes: Voluntary unaudited internal statistic at an explicit 2026-09-29 stock date. Covers equipment orders delivered but not yet recognised under PRC GAAP, plus equipment to be delivered later, so it is not all undelivered and it overlaps inventory shipped to customers. Company-wide; no product, region or customer split, and the tax basis is not stated. The 88.20% growth has no metric and is held in metric_proposals.json. The issuer warns the figure cannot be used to derive revenue or profit. ACM Research (Shanghai) consolidates into ACM Research, Inc.; subsidiary and parent figures overlap and must not be summed.
